create_fake_tensor_prop: create a FakeTensorProp instance to propagate fake tensor metadata through an FX graph module
run_fake_tensor_prop_node: run a single FX graph node and record its fake tensor value in the node's meta
propagate_fake_tensors: propagate fake tensors through an FX graph module with converted input tensors
